description: Two-panel layout: left panel with a small set of horizontal bars; right panel with a dense grid of small squares. Panels are separated visually by empty space/light divider (ignored).

components.description: Left panel containing a vertical stack of several horizontal bar rectangles of varying lengths, spaced apart.
Right panel consisting of a dense grid of many small, equal-sized square/rectangular cells arranged in rows and columns (heatmap-like).

primary.explanation: Five horizontal bars stacked vertically; items are arranged along the y dimension.
Approximate number of rows of small squares in the dense grid.

secondary.explanation: Approximate number of columns of small squares in the dense grid.
